meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 它会按功能梳理代码库,为每个功能画流程图,找出跨功能重复的代码或逻辑,提出统一架构,并生成可交给 /make-plan 的计划提示。所有产出保存在 PATHFINDER-日期 文件夹。
howto.when: 当你说“find the ideal path”、说要统一重复系统,或要求重构前先审计架构时,它就开始工作。

say.text: 帮我找到这个项目的理想路径。
say.note: 会先梳理功能清单并画流程图。

say.text: 这个项目里有两套重复的存储逻辑,帮我统一。
say.note: 会找出重复点并给出合并方案。

say.text: 重构前先审计一下项目架构。
say.note: 会生成架构审计和统一方案文档。

howto.what_en: It maps a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, finds duplicated concerns, proposes a unified architecture, and writes /make-plan handoff prompts. All outputs go to a PATHFINDER-<date> folder.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to 'find the ideal path,' to unify duplicated systems, or to audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Find the ideal path through this codebase.
say_en.note: Kicks off feature discovery and flowcharts.

say_en.text: Unify the two duplicated storage paths in this project.
say_en.note: Hunts for duplication and drafts a unified plan.

say_en.text: Audit the architecture before the refactor.
say_en.note: Produces an audit report and unified proposal.
